protocol.title: Pooled BTC+ETH disjoint-window OOS replication of the suggestive EVAL-65 options order-flow toxicity -> forward realized-vol slice (tox/imbalance, bar60, horizon 72), pooled-sample Spearman rank IC for power adequacy
protocol.extends: EVAL-65/EVAL-67 (identical signal/statistic/floor reused; BTC and ETH pooled into one rank-IC sample on a fresh disjoint real window)
protocol.supersedes: nothing — power-adequate pooled replication of the suggestive EVAL-65 slice; non-replication, underpowered, or BLOCKED is a valid sealed result
protocol.disjointness_rule: A capture is usable only if [window_start, window_end] does not overlap [2026-11-09T06:48:16Z, 2026-11-16T06:48:16Z]. Because the free Deribit perp 1m endpoint returns at most 5001 candles (300000 s), each capture must also span >=300000 s. The earliest floor-compliant end is 2026-11-19T18:08:16Z (sealed end + 300000 s); for margin use 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z or later. A naive trailing --days 7 capture before the sealed window has cleared will overlap and must seal BLOCKED.
protocol.capture_window_rule: Only after EVAL-67 has sealed: --underlying BTC --underlying ETH --days 3.7 --end <now-ISO> --out-dir data/raw/eval68 --seal. At end 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z this gives start 2026-11-16T07:12:00Z (disjoint from 2026-11-16T06:48:16Z; span 319680 s). Do not weaken the EVAL-64 floor.
protocol.signal: signal_z_k = expanding-zscore of per-bar options order-flow toxicity (tox) / signed-aggressor imbalance (imbalance), reused verbatim from EVAL-61/EVAL-62 (causal, end-of-bar k)
protocol.target: rv_{k+1..k+H} = sqrt(mean(log-return^2)) over the next H perp 1m/5m bars (forward realized vol, strictly after the decision at k)
protocol.statistic: Pooled Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(signal_z_k, rv_forward_k) over the concatenation of BTC and ETH pairs for each config
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, pooled across BTC+ETH and at least one of the pre-registered configs (tox::bar60::h72, imbalance::bar60::h72), the pooled Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, pooled pairs >= 790 (80% power), pooled BH-FDR rejects that config, the EVAL-64 floor is met on BOTH underlyings, and both capture windows are disjoint from the sealed window; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS) when floor+disjoint+power but not predictive, INCONCLUSIVE (UNDERPOWERED) when floor+disjoint but pooled pairs < 790, or BLOCKED when floor/disjoint fails.
